newsitem.title: INDIA: India statistical agency lowers 95/96 growth rate.
newsitem.headline: India statistical agency lowers 95/96 growth rate.

text.p: India's apex statistical agency has lowered the country's gross domestic product (GDP) growth estimate in 1995/96 (April-March) from 7.0 percent to 6.3 percent, the Economic Times newspaper said on Saturday.
It quoted the Central Statistical Organisation (CSO) sources as saying that a lower than expected agricultural production in 1995/96 had forced a downward revision of GDP growth rate.
The CSO is the apex government statistical agency responsible for collection and analysis of economic data.
The newspaper said that then informed of this downward revision of growth estimates in 1995/96.
The agriculture sector, which has a 30 percent weightage in the GDP, was expected to grow at one percent in 1995/96 but latest estimates suggest a negative growth of 3.19 percent in crop production.
India expects GDP to grow at 6.6 percent in the current fiscal ending on March 31, 1997.
